name: Telmisartan
class: Angiotensin II receptor blocker with partial PPAR-gamma activity
description: A long-acting angiotensin II receptor blocker approved for hypertension and cardiovascular risk reduction, with partial PPAR-gamma agonist activity that distinguishes it metabolically within the class. Boxed warning for foetal toxicity.

systems.note: Blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk reduction; the labelled indications.
Hyperkalaemia and creatinine rise are labelled.
Biliary excretion predominates; caution in hepatic impairment is labelled.

monitors.why: Partial PPAR-gamma activity gives this agent a metabolic effect the class otherwise lacks.
